visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black and orange baseball cap and a black t-shirt is seen in a medium close-up, leaning against a black railing inside a massive, brightly lit stadium. He is smiling and looking directly into the lens, gesturing with his right hand towards the empty green baseball field in the background. (2) The camera cuts to a wide shot of the baseball field where several players are scattered. In the foreground, a group of cheerleaders in white uniforms are performing a synchronized routine on a platform. The stadium stands are visible in the background, showing thousands of empty or partially filled gray and white seats. (3) The perspective returns to the man, who is now much more expressive, using both hands to emphasize his excitement. He continues to smile, showing teeth, while the blurred background reveals the depth of the stadium stands behind him. (4) A sweeping pan shot displays the stadium's seating sections, which are populated by a large crowd of spectators. The lighting is uniform and bright across the entire indoor sports venue. (5) The man is shown again in a close-up, talking animatedly. He occasionally looks off-camera and then back, maintaining a joyful and engaging facial expression while leaning over the metal railing of the spectator stand. (6) A young woman with short dark hair and a small pink bow is introduced. She waves happily at the camera initially, then is shown performing a high-energy dance on a stage. She wears a white cropped t-shirt and dark jeans. A large yellow bird-like mascot is seen dancing alongside her. (7) The final phase shows the man in an indoor concourse or hallway. The background features structural concrete pillars and industrial lighting. He continues speaking to the camera in a relaxed manner, still wearing his distinct sun-logo baseball cap.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and positive valence, projecting clearly over a low-level stadium background hum. The speech is rhythmic and enthusiastic. No background music is present in this initial phase. (2) Energetic, high-tempo pop music begins to play, featuring a strong electronic beat. A female voice is heard shouting synchronized cheers into a microphone, accompanied by the distinct sound of rhythmic applause from a large crowd. (3) The music continues at a steady pace. The female voice leads a series of call-and-response chants. The crowd responds with high-arousal shouting, creating a dense and vibrant acoustic environment typical of a live sports event. (4) The audio transitions to a quieter indoor space with noticeable room resonance. The primary male voice returns, speaking in a more relaxed, conversational tone with frequent small pauses and light, casual laughter. The background music is gone, replaced by faint indoor ambient noise.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a personal vlog documenting the creator's visit to the Taipei Dome to support a family member (his sister) who is performing as a cheerleader. It highlights the atmosphere of the stadium and provides a personal commentary on the performance and the differences between home and away games.
